newsitem.title: USA: L.B. Foster buys $1.5 mln railroad stock.
newsitem.headline: L.B. Foster buys $1.5 mln railroad stock.

text.p: L.B. Foster Co said Thursday that it has acquired $1.5 million of series B preferred stock and warrants of privately-held Dakota, Minnesota & Eastern Railroad Corp.
The company said that the acquisition allows it to maintain its ownership of about 13 percent of the railroad's outstanding common stock, on a fully diluted basis.

Dakota, said the company, raised $7 million by selling preferred stock and warrants to its existing shareholders, to further its planned expansion into the low sulfur coal fields of the Powder River Basin and for general corporate purposes.
L.B. Foster is a manufacturer, distributor and fabricator of rail, construction and tubular products.
